Name: Cat Valley(Interface)
Author: RimeNovi
Description:
[center][b][font=Times New Roman][color=#3d85c6][size=6][/size][/color][/font][/b][/center][left][b][font=Times New Roman][color=#3d85c6][size=6]猫露谷物语
Cat Valley
[/size][/color][/font][/b]

[color=#f1c232][b]一个以春天、猫咪、花朵、手账本为灵感制作的用户界面。
[/b]A user interface mod inspired by spring,cats, flowers, and personal journals.
[/color][color=#f1c232][b]这是我第一次制作并发布mod，我认为这是一件值得纪念的事，所以我选择在生日这天发布，如果可以，请告诉我感想，这会让我很开心(´∀_)ﾉ！[/b]
[/color][color=#f1c232]As my first creation and public release, I find this project truly memorable. To celebrate, I’m launching it on my birthday! If you try it, I’d be delighted to hear your thoughts—your feedback would make me so happy (_´∀)ﾉ!



[/color][color=#1e84cc]
[/color][font=Times New Roman][color=#1e84cc][size=6][b]本模组支持以下语言
[/b][/size][/color][/font][b][font=Times New Roman][color=#1e84cc][size=6]Supported Languages

[/size][/color][/font][/b][color=#f1c232][b]英语，中文，日语，韩语，德语，西班牙语，俄语，意大利语，土耳其语，法语，葡萄牙语，匈牙利语。[/b]
[/color][color=#f1c232]English,Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish, Russian, Italian, Turkish, French, Portuguese, Hungarian.





[/color][font=Times New Roman][color=#1e84cc][size=6][b]如何安装[/b]
[/size][/color][/font][b][font=Times New Roman][color=#1e84cc][size=6]Installation Guide
[/size][/color][/font]

[/b][color=#f1c232][b]       1.下载并安装[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b][/color][color=#f1c232]         
         Download and install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
      [b]2.下载前置模组（[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ & [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿）[/b][/color][color=#f1c232]       
         Download required framework mods ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ & [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿).
[/color][color=#f1c232]      [b]3.在该模组文件界面下载需要的文件[/b]
[/color][color=#f1c232]         Download the main mod files from this page.
[/color][color=#f1c232]      [b]4.将下载好的文件解压并放置在Mods文件夹内[/b]
[/color][color=#f1c232]         Extract the files and place them into your "Mods" folder.




[/color]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#1e84cc][size=6][b]注意[/b]
[/size][/color][/font][b][font=Times New Roman][size=6][color=#1e84cc]Notes
[/color]
[/size][/font][/b][color=#f1c232][b]1.这个MOD文件还包含了对开场动画的美化（Minigames/Cloude），所以存在与其他MOD冲突的可能（例如一部分美化了同类项的着色模组），如果出现贴图失效的情况，请仔细检查这点。[/b]
[/color][color=#f1c232]This mod includes a redesigned opening animation (located in Minigames/Cloude), which may conflict with other mods that alter the same elements. If textures fail to load, please check for possible conflicts.

[b]2.我试着制作了移动端也适用的UI，但由于我从来没有游玩过移动端的星露谷物语，所以还没有试用过，如果无法使用或存在问题，希望您能在评论区告知我（PC端同理）。
[/b][/color][color=#f1c232]I’ve attempted to adapt the UI for mobile devices, but as I haven't tested it on the mobile version, I can’t guarantee full compatibility. If you encounter issues on mobile (or PC), please let me know in the comments!




[/color]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#1e84cc][size=6][b]致谢
[/b][/size][/color][/font][b][font=Times New Roman][color=#1e84cc][size=6]Acknowledgments
[/size][/color][/font][/b]

[color=#f1c232][b]感谢我的朋友TCP协议与夏城春野在制作过程中给予的帮助和支持。
[/b][/color][color=#f1c232]Special thanks to my friends TCP Xie Yi and Xia Cheng Chun Ye for their help and support throughout the creation process.
[/color][color=#f1c232][b]
感谢所有在制作期间对这个作品表达过喜爱的人。[/b]
[/color][color=#f1c232]Thank you to everyone who expressed interest and encouragement while this mod was in development.
[/color][color=#f1c232][b]
祝你们拥有美好的游戏时光。[/b]
[/color][color=#f1c232]Wishing you all a wonderful time in the game![/color][/left]



@RimeNovi
